image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a black assault rifle (resembling an AR-15/M4 platform) against a plain white background. Visible components include the upper receiver with a Picatinny rail, a portion of the handguard, the magazine well with an inserted box magazine, the trigger guard, pistol grip, and the beginning of the stock. The barrel extends to the left but is cut off by the frame.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific model variant (e.g., M4 vs AR-15) and ensure no misclassification as a toy or non-functional prop.
To verify the physical connectivity between the magazine and the magazine well, ensuring no floating elements or fusion artifacts.
To check for structural consistency in the cylindrical barrel and rectangular receiver shapes, ensuring no warping or perspective collapse.
To assess overall sharpness and detect any subtle noise or compression artifacts that mimic AI generation errors.

focus_areas: Mechanical integrity of the magazine well connection
Sharpness and definition of the Picatinny rail details
Linearity of the receiver and barrel axis
Texture differentiation between metal and polymer components
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'fusion' risk between the magazine and the lower receiver. AI often blurs this connection. Also, verify if the Picatinny rail teeth are individually distinct or if they melt into a single ridge. Check if the trigger guard geometry is physically plausible (open loop vs closed blob).
